C-FORWARD Ph3 HCV topline guided early 2027 (slipped from YE26), NDA mid-2027; same regimen as the positive C-BEYOND (Jul-26). De-risked replicate binary, stock flat near cash; asymmetry real but months out.

verified.catalyst: Topline from the Phase 3 ARCHER II trial of vonaprument in geographic atrophy (month-15 primary endpoint, vision protection measured as BCVA loss of 15 letters or more), which the company says is on track for Q4 2026.
verified.dated_milestone: ARCHER II month-15 topline guided for Q4 2026, so by about 2026-12-31 (reconfirmed in the Q3 release of 2026-11-09). Next: tanruprubart GBS BLA submission guided for Q4 2026, with the PDUFA date roughly 10-12 months after it is filed; the EU MAA is under review.
verified.instrument: ANNX common (Nasdaq). Size it as a binary: small position or defined-risk options. Do not hold it as a value seat.
verified.bloom_gates: G2 is met: the company publicly committed to a Q4 2026 date for the month-15 primary readout and reconfirmed it 2026-11-09. G1 does not apply (no counterparty). G3 is only partly met: the upside depends on approval odds and the size of the GA market, not on a contractual figure.
verified.edge: M. Run-up from the pre-catalyst base is about -33% to -50%, not positive: the price is $3.41 against a 200-day average of $5.06 and a 52-week high of $7.18. The stock sits at its 52-week low ($3.355) going into the readout, so none of the result has been harvested. Remaining capture: a success case of roughly $10-13/share (a GA franchise competing with Syfovre/Izervay plus the GBS asset) is about +190% to +280% from $3.41. A failure floor of about $1.3/share net cash plus about $0.5-1.0 for GBS/ANX1502 gives $1.8-2.3, about -35% to -45%. At an assumed 35-40% chance of success, the probability-weighted value is about $5.5-6.0, roughly +65% expected. The edge is only M because the Phase 2 ARCHER result came from a secondary/exploratory vision endpoint (it missed lesion growth), so the replication risk is real.

The Q3 release (2026-11-09) says the ARCHER II month-15 primary assessment is "on track for Q4 2026", cash and investments were $213M at 2026-09-30 with runway into 2028, the GBS BLA submission is expected in Q4 2026 (so no PDUFA date yet), and the EU MAA is under review. verified.catalyst: The FDA has accepted the Anaphylm (dibutepinephrine sublingual film) NDA resubmission as a Class 2 response, with a PDUFA goal date of 2027-03-16. If approved, it would be the first oral rescue drug for anaphylaxis.
verified.dated_milestone: PDUFA 2027-03-16. Before then: Piper Sandler conference Dec 1-3, 2026, Health Canada filing in Q4 2026, EU filing in Q1 2027.
verified.instrument: AQST common stock (NASDAQ). Long equity into the PDUFA; staging the position is better than one buy, because of dilution risk around approval.
verified.bloom_gates: G1 (FDA is the named counterparty) and G2 (a set PDUFA goal date of 2027-03-16 under a Class 2 resubmission) both pass. G3 passes only partly: the unpriced figure is the gap back to the pre-CRL price of about $6.2 (about $780M market cap) against $3.71 today ($466M). That gap is derived from price history, not contractual.
verified.edge: M. The run-up from the pre-catalyst base is NEGATIVE. The resubmission became knowable with the August 2026 human-factors/PK topline; the price was $3.94 on 2026-08-07 and is $3.71 now, about -6%. Measured from the post-CRL low of $2.95 (2026-01-30) it is +26%. The stock fell from $4.61 to $3.78 when the FDA accepted the resubmission (2026-10-14 to 10-16), so the date is not being bid up. Remaining capture to a favorable-resolution value of about $6.0 (pre-CRL level, less some dilution) is about +62%. Probability-weighted with an assumed 80% approval chance and a $2.0 floor on a second CRL, it is about $5.2, or +40%. Most of the event is unharvested. Edge is held at M rather than H because the market's discount probably reflects a real commercial ceiling (neffy is already on the market), cash runway, and an expected raise.
verified.primary_source: Aquestive press release 'FDA Acceptance of Anaphylm NDA Resubmission and PDUFA Goal Date of March 16, 2027' (GlobeNewswire, 2026-10-15); Q3 2026 results PR (2026-11-03); FMP Q3-2026 balance sheet (filed 2026-11-03); FMP EOD prices through 2026-11-19 and quote of 2026-11-20 ($3.705).
verified.analysis: The event is real, dated and forward. The FDA classed the resubmission as Class 2 with a PDUFA date of 2026-03-16 2027 per the 2026-10-15 press release, and the resubmission rests on positive August-2026 human-factors and PK data. That fits the triage claim that the January 2026 CRL was about human factors and packaging, but I could not re-verify the CRL text: the web-search budget was exhausted. The price has not run up. AQST trades at $3.71, below its pre-resubmission level and about 40% under the pre-CRL $6.2. The equity waterfall: no preferred stock, $90.3M cash, $8.1M lease and debt, about $147M of other non-current liabilities that are most likely royalty-monetization obligations (unverified) and sit ahead of the common's share of Anaphylm economics, and a $70.8M equity deficit. That leaves room for a re-rate on approval, but a post-approval raise is likely, and the royalty stack caps how much of the upside reaches the common. It stays WATCH, not ACTIVE, because the binary is 4 months out, there is a pending securities-suit investigation, and the commercial competition from neffy was not quantified.

verified.catalyst: C-FORWARD Phase 3 topline for bemnifosbuvir/ruzasvir (BEM/RZR) in HCV, guided for early 2027. It is a replicate of the positive C-BEYOND trial, and an NDA would follow in mid-2027 if C-FORWARD is positive.
verified.dated_milestone: C-FORWARD topline, guided early 2027 (Q1 2027 per the board dossier). Then NDA submission around Q2/mid-2027. Next hard date: the Q4/FY26 report, roughly Mar 2027.
verified.bloom_gates: G2 (company-guided topline window and NDA plan). Partial G3: the cash floor is quantifiable from the 10-Q. G1 not met: no named counterparty or partner. The Hercules facility is financing and does not validate the thesis.
verified.edge: M. Run-up from the pre-catalyst base is NEGATIVE. The stock is $3.93, against $5.10 at the board's last pass, a 50-day average of $4.68 and a 52-week high of $6.45, so nothing has been harvested and the C-BEYOND win from July 2026 has been given back. Remaining capture is about +75-80% to roughly $7 on a C-FORWARD win; that $7 is inherited from the board's +37% from $5.10 and NOT re-derived from a commercial model. Downside to a burn-adjusted cash floor is about -45 to -55% (roughly $1.8-2.4 per share). Edge comes from a de-risked replicate trading at only about $125M EV. It is capped by the months-long wait and a crowded HCV market dominated by generics and incumbents.

verified.analysis: FMP 10-Q data (filed 2026-11-09) shows Q3 cash plus investments of $191.2M, no debt (lease $0.2M) and no preferred stock. Against a $316M market cap that is about $2.39 per share of cash and about $125M EV, so the triage line "flat near cash" overstates the cushion: the price is about 1.6x cash. The Hercules facility of up to $200M (2026-11-09) will sit ahead of the common once drawn. The event is real, dated and unfired, and a replicate of a trial that already met its endpoints carries high probability. A rough expected value is about +30% (0.65 x $7 + 0.35 x $1.9, against $3.93), but the payoff is 2-4+ months out and the commercial value of the win is unverified. That justifies WATCH at 5 rather than ACTIVE.
